spec.description:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Polka is a two-piece modular acoustic desk divider
featuring a playful, stepped dual-panel profile. Designed to provide targeted
acoustic dampening (0.70 Sabins per unit) while creating an open, dynamic desk
boundary, Polka attaches non-destructively to desks via Vicinity Desk Clamps.
Made from 100% polyester fibre with an 80% recycled PET core, it provides
Group 1 fire compliance and certified carbon neutrality.

install: Unpack Polka panel components (772mm and 380mm panels)

Slide Vicinity Clamps
into the routed slots on both screen sections

Position the stepped panels
along the desk perimeter to achieve desired layout

Tighten the clamp screws
from underneath the desk using an Allen key

Ensure both stepped panels are
securely clamped and upright

limitations: Indoor use only; avoid wet areas or direct liquid contact
Clamps require adequate desk edge lip for attachment

Two-piece stepped

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Polka
is a playful two-piece stepped acoustic desk divider comprising 772mm and 380mm
wide panels formed from 12mm Cube polyester felt. Absorbing 0.70 Sabins per
unit, its asymmetrical stepped geometry introduces visual rhythm while
mitigating speech distractions across agile workstations. Fixed
non-destructively using 100% recycled PET Vicinity Clamps and achieving Group 1
fire compliance, Polka provides a flexible, carbon-neutral privacy barrier for
collaborative and creative workspaces.
